thread:
maria: Hey team, new billing oddity: customer saw provisional ~1.3k in console, confirmed ~1.0k, invoice ~2.1k. Trace suggests stream + tool_call + client resume -> multiple provisional records.

josh: can you drop trace id?

maria: trace_2026_07_01_11. Sequence: stream open -> 2 provisional slices -> tool_call -> client reconnect -> resume -> router fallback -> truncated final. Router did two handoffs and we recorded provisional for both.

lee: quick root cause: provisional records are keyed by session_id + token_range. When reconnects create a new session_id, ledger stitcher sees separate provisional entries. The finalizer merges in a way that sometimes double-counts overlapping ranges when attempt provenance is missing.

ana: thought: what if we attach a lightweight provenance hash to each attempt that captures (client_id, initial_request_id, attempt_seq) and include that in provisional events? Ledger could dedupe by provenance_hash + token_range. Lower cardinality than full UUIDs.

sam: +1. provenance_hash could be 128-bit truncated sha1 of stable fields, cheap to index.

josh: alternative: add X-Redwood-Billing-Attempt header (uuid) that survives reconnects. Router synthesizes when client absent and emits Set-Cookie so clients reuse on resume. Ledger dedupe on attempt_id. Simpler for reasoning.

lee: both viable. Hash approach helps debug when client omitted header (we can compute same hash server-side). attempt header easier for clients to correlate. We could implement both: attempt_id primary, provenance_hash as fallback.

ana: storage note: provisional TTL = 7d. Adding attempt_id/provenance_hash increases index cardinality but per-session QPS is low. I'll run an index-cost sim.

maria: console impact: Ops were panicking because provisional shown prominently. Immediate mitigation: hide provisional by default and add banner: "Provisional estimates may change during finalization." Also add an "attempts" drilldown to see tokens grouped by attempt_id or provenance_hash.

console-ux: Agree. UX suggestion: default "confirmed" view, with an optional "provisional (transient)" overlay. Also add a small confidence pill per attempt: e.g., confidence = 1 - min(0.5, retries/5) so users see unstable attempts.

josh: interesting — confidence score could be derived from number of reconnections/tool_call hops. We can emit streaming.provisional_confidence metric with tags.

maria: ledger changes: dedupe rule should be (customer_id, attempt_id OR provenance_hash, token_window). Finalizer must be idempotent and de-duplicate overlap by taking the max tokens per token_index range across attempts with same provenance.

lee: rollout plan: 1) front-end hide provisional default (quick). 2) router/proxy synth attempt header + cookie (medium). 3) ledger dedupe (behind feature flag + mirror-run) (medium). 4) confidence score + attempts drilldown + opt-in smoothing UX (later).

ops-bot: Alert suppressed: provisional_spike for cust_delta at 2026-07-01T16:22Z.

maria: telemetry: new metrics.streaming.provisional_tokens, streaming.confirmed_tokens, billing.attempt_dedupe_collapses, streaming.provisional_confidence{customer,attempt}. Add dashboard panel that shows provisional/confirmed/invoice for last 1h and attempts map for top 10 attempts.

josh: quick smoothing heuristic idea: while finalization pending, show smoothed = confirmed + (provisional - confirmed) * decay(t) where decay(t) = exp(-t / tau) with tau=300s. That avoids big spikes but surfaces movement. Make it opt-in per org.

console-ux: We'll prototype both the confidence pill and exponential smoothing opt-in. Default to turned off.

lee: migration compatibility: ledger finalizer must accept both new events (with attempt_id/provenance_hash) and old ones (session-only). For old events, finalizer falls back to existing session-based dedupe. Add migration doc and consumer changes.

ana: I'll open tickets: ISSUE-9010 (console hide provisional + UI work), ISSUE-9011 (attempt header + router cookie), ISSUE-9012 (ledger dedupe + mirror-run), ISSUE-9013 (telemetry + dashboard). Assigning lee/josh/maria per area.

maria: I'll draft RFC-241 covering provenance_hash vs attempt_id tradeoffs and include repro script. Include billing/sre/legal.

josh: For immediate, I'm taking ISSUE-9010 and will push a small frontend patch today to hide provisional and add banner.

lee: I'll build a reproducible script that simulates stream slices, tool_call, forced reconnects with and without attempt header. Will run index-cost sim and post numbers by EOD.

maria: cool. tests: unit tests for dedupe logic, e2e in billing-staging with mirror-run to validate invoice parity. Also add an ops runbook snippet to check for multiple session_ids in short windows for same client.

billing-bot: InvoiceEvent: provisional_charge emitted for cust_delta evt_9999 at 2026-07-01T16:22:35Z.

maria: thanks everyone. We'll sync on RFC review in next platform meeting. If recon reports come in, correlate to provenance_hash/attempt header.

sam: small note: consider adding a short-lived shard key for provenance to reduce hot index buckets if cardinality spikes. We'll see from cost sim.

ana: noted. I'll include that in cost sim.

maria: great. closing for now.
